answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond and earn attestations from established peers before its votes carry weight. Picture the network as an island where each inlet has a checkpoint: a newcomer is sponsored in by a known member, and a quill-signed record of useful work is what builds its reputation. An attacker spinning up clones must fund a bond per clone and wait out the reputation ramp, so flooding costs far more than any single vote can gain, while one honest agent amortizes a single bond over a long career.
